items.wordHook: A 亻(person) holds up a flawless 圭(jade tablet) to show it is fine and 佳(good).
Combining 公(public) and 共(all): 公共 means public.
Combining 冷(cold) and 靜(still): 冷靜 means calm down.
Combining 劇(theatrical plays) and 本(this): 劇本 means script.
Combining 只(only) and 是(be): 只是 means but then.
Sampling fine cuisine with an appreciative 口(mouth): 味(taste).

a 干(dry) field flattens under 丷(horns) pressing down → 平(flat).
看(look) + 到(arrive) → your look arrives at it, seeing it by chance: 看到(see).
Combining 社(group) and 會(meet): 社會 means society.
